scenes.text: In this town, no one says their own name after dark.
scenes.art_prompt: a narrow foggy street of old houses at night, one warm window lit, long shadows, unsettling calm

scenes.text: They write it on paper instead, and keep the paper close.
scenes.art_prompt: a handwritten note resting on a dark wooden table, single candle, deep shadows

scenes.text: One morning, every note in the house was blank.
scenes.art_prompt: an open drawer full of blank slips of paper, dim bedroom light, quiet dread

scenes.text: Except one, folded small, in her own handwriting.
scenes.art_prompt: a single folded paper held in a trembling hand, faint moonlight, tense atmosphere

scenes.text:
It wasn't her name on it.
It was the name of the thing that answered.
scenes.art_prompt: a dark hallway where a doorway stands slightly ajar, a shape hinted in the black beyond

scenes.text: Follow for more Quiet Horror Files.
scenes.art_prompt: an old house at the end of a fog-filled street, all lights out, final quiet dread
